OpenSimAnt - a fan remake of SimAnt (1991)
==========================================

This is a test build. Thanks for trying it!

WHAT YOU NEED

  * Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), macOS 12 or newer (Apple Silicon or Intel), or a 64-bit
    Linux desktop (x86_64).
  * Nothing else. The remake comes with its own art, text, sound and music -- new work
    made for OpenSimAnt, called the open assets -- so you do not need the original game.

    If you do own the DOS version of SimAnt, you can play with the original's look
    instead: point the game at your copy and it uses the original's art, text, sound and
    music. That folder has these files in it (upper or lower case names both work):

        SIMANT.EXE   HCEGANT.DAT   HCEGANT.NDX   SHARED.DAT   SHARED.NDX   SOUND.DAT   SOUND.NDX

    (Only the first three are required. Without SHARED and SOUND there are no menus or
    sounds.) This is optional: the open assets need no files at all.

STARTING THE GAME

  Windows
    1. Right-click the zip you downloaded and choose "Extract All...", then open the
       extracted folder. (Running it straight from inside the zip won't work.)
    2. Double-click OpenSimAnt.exe.
       Windows may show a blue box saying "Windows protected your PC". That happens because
       this test build isn't signed. Click "More info", then "Run anyway".

  macOS
    1. Double-click the zip you downloaded; it unpacks into a "OpenSimAnt" folder. Move
       OpenSimAnt.app wherever you like (Applications, or leave it there).
    2. The build isn't signed by an Apple developer, so the first time macOS refuses to open it.
       Right-click (or Control-click) OpenSimAnt.app and choose "Open", then "Open" again.
       On macOS 15 and newer: double-click it once, close the warning, then open System Settings >
       Privacy & Security, scroll down and click "Open Anyway" next to OpenSimAnt.
       (If macOS says the app "is damaged", open Terminal and run:
            xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /path/to/OpenSimAnt.app
        dragging the app into the Terminal window types its path for you.)

  Linux
    1. Unpack the archive:   tar xzf OpenSimAnt-*-linux.tar.gz
    2. Run it:               ./OpenSimAnt/OpenSimAnt.x86_64
       (Keep the "data_..." folder next to it: the game needs it.)

  Then, on every system:
    3. The game starts with a choice: "Open assets: no original files needed" (the game's
       own art, text, sound and music) or "Original look: use my copy of SimAnt" (your own
       copy of the original, as above). Press Enter to repeat your last choice. With the
       original look the game asks, the first time, where your SimAnt files are: pick the
       folder with SIMANT.EXE in it (picking the folder just above it works too). It
       remembers the folder; "Change folder..." picks another one.

       Shortcut: if you copy your SimAnt files into the same folder as the game (or into a
       folder next to it; on macOS, next to OpenSimAnt.app), the game finds them by itself and
       skips the question. This only matters for the original look.

PLAYING

  The screen works like the original game: the menus are along the top, and the game starts
  at the title screen.

  Mouse: click on the map to walk the yellow ant there (either button). Double-click (either
  button) to act on what you clicked: pick up, drop, eat, dig, meet or fight. Press and hold
  the left button on an ant or a brood for the Ant Info of it; it goes away when you let go.
  Press and hold on the yellow ant for its own menu.

  Keyboard (as in the original): Space or Insert is the left mouse button and Delete the
  right one. Pause with the PAUSE button, the Speed menu or Shift+0; Shift+1 to Shift+4 set
  the speed Slow, Normal, Fast and Ultra. The arrow keys (and the numeric keypad) scroll the
  map while Control is held down; Home goes back to the yellow ant. The keys 1, 2, 3, 4, X
  and 0 give the yellow ant its orders (recruit, release, exchange, alarm trail); the menus
  show their own letters underlined.

  The open assets are new art, text, sound and music, close to the original but not copies
  of it, so some screens and sounds will differ from what you remember. If something looks
  broken or missing on them, that is a bug in this build.

  Saved games are kept in:
    Windows:  %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\OpenSimAnt
              (paste that into the address bar of a File Explorer window to open it)
    macOS:    ~/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/OpenSimAnt
              (in Finder: Go > Go to Folder..., then paste it)
    Linux:    ~/.local/share/godot/app_userdata/OpenSimAnt

IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG

  * Choosing the folder says the files aren't there: make sure the folder really has
    SIMANT.EXE, HCEGANT.DAT and HCEGANT.NDX in it. The Windows version of SimAnt has
    different files and won't work; it has to be the DOS version. (If you only want to
    play, choose "Open assets" instead: it needs no files.)

  * Something on the open assets looks wrong or missing: that is a bug in this build, not
    something you did. Tell whoever sent you this, and say which screen it is.

  * To choose a different SimAnt folder, delete settings.cfg from the saved-games folder
    above and start the game again.

  * Anything else (a crash, something that looks wrong, something that doesn't work like
    the original): tell whoever sent you this, and say which system you're on and what you
    were doing when it happened. A screenshot helps a lot.
